1.mascotDialogue: Left is always smaller, right is always bigger, at every single node — not merely the root. Break this rule anywhere, and it ceases to be a BST at all. Non négociable.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 12 and 13 — the ordering rule, made literal in code. Smaller goes left, bigger goes right, recursively, all the way down.

3.mascotDialogue: 20 sits left of 30, which already sits left of 50 — every step down, the rule holds again. Consistent, if nothing else.

4.mascotDialogue: The tree still looks like a tree — this is precisely what makes the bug so easy to miss. It is wrong only relative to the rule, not wrong in shape. A forgery, not a ruin.
